div.div: 1 حَضَا النَّارَ , (K,) first pers. حَضَوْتُ, (S,) inf. n. حَضْوٌ, (K,) He lighted, or kindled, the fire; or made it to burn, burn up, burn brightly or fiercely, blaze, or flame: (S:) or he stirred the live coals of the fire after they had become [partially] extinguished. (K. [هَمَدَ, there, seems to be a mistake for خَمَدَ.]) It is also with ء. (S, TA. [See art. حضأ.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
